messages:
tara: Quick sync — I'm proposing we add a "sentinel" pass to the onboarding pipeline to catch subtle regressions earlier. Short sketch: lightweight bench (<=10 inputs), deterministic seeds, checksum/shape compatibility, and a delta-regression gate that can block rollouts. Thoughts?

leo: Do you mean run sentinel on every model push? cost concern.

tara: Not every push. Canary + preflight for large models. Cheap sentinel on ingest (CPU microbench) + fuller canary run when capacity available.

maria: We need strict determinism for the sentinel to be useful. Also tolerances per metric, not global. Example config: 
```json
{
  "sentinel_enabled": true,
  "inputs": "golden_small.json",
  "seed": 42,
  "metrics": {
    "p50_latency_ms": {"threshold": 40},
    "exact_match_rate": {"tolerance_pct": 0.5}
  },
  "run_on_ingest": "fast",
  "run_on_canary": "full"
}
```

sachin: +1 for per-metric tolerances. Also add a compatibility probe for tokenizer/vocab drift — we had a case where byte-level tokenization changed shaping.

ben: Operational question: if sentinel fails, do we block the model from being promoted or just flag? We should distinguish hard failures (schema break, missing KV cache) vs soft regressions (small perf drop).

tara: My proposal: hard failures => block. soft regressions => create a regression ticket and require explicit ACK to bypass (and auto-fallback to previous pinned variant).

leo: How do we compute regression delta? Use previous pinned model running the same sentinel inputs. Need a stable baseline snapshot.

maria: We should snapshot both numeric metrics and sample outputs (hashes) so we can quickly triage noisy diffs. Example output digest step: 
```bash
# run sentinel, produce outputs.json
sha256sum outputs.json > outputs.sha256
compare outputs.sha256 with baseline.sha256
```

infra-bot: bench-run queued: model=redwood-x-lite, run_id=br-2026-03-21-07 queued by tara

sachin: We also need to think about caching: sentinel should bypass cache to measure cold path for KV priming, but bench can also run warm-path to validate KV-cache correctness. Two modes.

ben: Agree. Also add a flag to the sentinel config to run in "replay" mode against live traces for stochastic checks.

tara: Good call. I'll draft the follow-up RFC covering: sentinel config schema, baseline snapshot lifecycle, soft/hard gating rules, and cost/accounting. Link incoming.

deploy-bot: Canary run started for model=redwood-x-lite, canary_id=c-7789, triggered by bench-run br-2026-03-21-07

leo: One last thing — make sure the sentinel suite is small and versioned with the model entry. We don't want silent drift if golden inputs change.

tara: Agreed. Golden inputs + sentinel harness are part of the model artifact. I'll post RFC draft in #eng-ml later today. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks — will review and suggest tolerance values based on recent bench distributions.

ben: If anyone has real examples of false positives from past onboards, drop them here so we can tune thresholds.

tara: Will collect and include.
